create_issue_emoji_reaction.description: Add an emoji reaction to an issue (e.g. thumbsup, rocket, eyes). Use this for a new resource or action; choose the corresponding update or edit tool when the resource already exists. It changes remote GitLab state and requires the necessary project or group permission; GitLab returns validation, conflict, permission, or rate-limit errors instead of silently applying an invalid request. When `project_id` or `group_id` is accepted, provide the numeric ID or complete URL-encoded path described by the schema; use required identifiers and pagination fields exactly as documented.

name.description: Name of the emoji without colons (e.g. 'thumbsup', 'rocket', 'eyes')

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project
